record.when: Saturation adjustment is requested. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Accept 0; record requested=0 and effective=0.

record.given: Immutable source/version and supported profile with factor 2.
record.when: Saturation adjustment is requested. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Accept 2; record requested=2 and effective=2.

record.given: Valid source/profile; factor omitted.
record.when: Saturation adjustment is requested. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Use candidate default 1; record requested/default and effective values.

record.given: Valid source/profile with factor 1.
record.when: Saturation adjustment is requested. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Record requested=1 and effective=1.

record.given: Valid source/profile with factor 1.01.
record.when: Validate request. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Accept hundredth-step value.

record.given: Factor below 0 or above 2.
record.when: Validate request. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Reject BOUNDS_EXCEEDED without clamp/substitution.

record.given: Factor has more than two decimal places.
record.when: Validate request. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Reject INVALID_REQUEST without rounding.

record.given: NaN or positive/negative infinity is supplied.
record.when: Validate request. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Reject INVALID_REQUEST.

record.given: Profile/color space is unsupported or unknown.
record.when: Adjustment is requested. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Reject/return UNKNOWN without substitution.

record.given: Source artifact version is absent.
record.when: Adjustment is requested. Parent relation: MEDIA-REQ-CAP-COLOR includes capability media.color.saturation.
record.then: Return UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE; create no candidate.
